column4: Methodology for measure of open data impact and reuse is in draft version, to be complete in June 2023. Methodology implement several activities which will take place in late 2023, including interviews with online form for portal users. Activities include: analysis of web analytics, surveys (for data stewards, data users, one survey for companies, NGO and academia focused on impact). Survey for data users will ask on users satisfaction with portal and data quality. Methodology implements metrics for user requests satisfaction (on quality of data request or to publish new data request) and if most requested data (discovered by separate survey - Q38) are published.* *updated

column4: There are 95 data providers on portal which are mainly public bodies on national level. Regional providers are not required to publish open data, it is only optional. Harvesting this data on national open data is still problem, national open data team is working on technical solutions to help harvest all regional dataset on national portal.
